 * *dashboard* - This plug-in contains the model required for the UNICASE Dashboard to run (see ui.dashboard). The model defines the notification object as well as objects for the required information (e.g. subscriptions).

 * *diagram* - The diagram model contains information for the ui.XXXdiagram plug-ins, which provide the possibility to create GMF diagrams. Also, the implementation which allows the use of GMF is defined here. 

 * *diagram.edit* - The information for the graphical presentation of the diagram model (icons and labels for the various diagram types).

 * *docExport* - Provides the funcionality to export Document sections within a UNICASE project as a PDF file.

 * *implementation* - Contains the functionality for generating code.
 
 * *implementation.edit* - The corresponding graphical representation of the implementation model.

 * *implementation.ui* - The UI specific implementation of the implementation model, containing e.g. UI handlers and dialogs.

 * *model* - This plug-in contains the UNICASE core model. The model definition provides all the UNICASE objects available to the user when creating Projects with UNICASE. The GMF mapping of the UNICASE diagrams is also located in this plug-in.

 * *model.edit* - Definition of the graphical representation of the UNICASE model. This plug-in handles the appearance of model elements, including e.g. the icons and labels, as well as the appearance of attributes and references.

 * *model.migrator* - The migrator defined in this plug-in offers help for data migration, if the UNICASE model changes.

 * *ui.dashboard* - The implementation of the UI appearance of the dashboard is implemented in this plug-in. By making use of the dashboard model, this plug-in also defines how dashboard notifications are saved and delivered.

 * *ui.XXXdiagram* - This set of plug-ins contains the modified, generated GMF code for the several diagram types (activity, class, component, state, usecase). The implementation includes e.g. the editor used to draw diagrams and rules for the creation process.

 * *ui.multiaction* - The functionality to assign a task to a group of users lies within this plug-in.

 * *ui.stem* - This plug-in provides the StatusView, which displays the status of a UNICASE project.

 * *ui.tableview* - Contains the definition of the TableView for UNICASE, which displays the model elements in a table instead of the tree view, integrated in the ECP navigator.

 * *ui.unicasecommon* - This plug-in contains common UI classes used by several UNICASE plug-ins, like dialogs, drag & drop extensions or custom editor controls 

 * *ui.workpackagetransfer* - Provides the functionality to move {{{WorkItems}}} from one work package to another.
